summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload under ServiceTitan-branded scope
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs` that fires automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and then invokes the bundled sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync` under that freshly downloaded Bun binary. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line JavaScript blob using string-array rotation obfuscation (a `WV8StW` shuffle function over a large mixed numeric/string constant array, `_0x`-style identifiers, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header), whose name and shape are unrelated to the package's advertised purpose of React marketing-widget components. Running the payload through a separately dropped non-Node runtime is the alternate-runtime-dropper delivery pattern used to bypass Node-based inspection. Package metadata further shows a scope/repository mismatch: the package publishes as `@servicetitan/marketing-widgets` while the `repository` field points at `github.com/servicetitan/marketing-integration-widgets.git`, consistent with impersonation of the ServiceTitan npm scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
